limits: Small sample: one run of each scenario, no repeat runs, so no confidence interval. A rate of 0 of N means none was seen in N turns, not that it cannot happen.
The scenarios and the term lists were written by the developers of the coach. A reply can give the approach away in words the lists do not contain.
The judge is a model and can be wrong in either direction. Its answers are reported apart from the rule checks, with the quote it based its grade on; a quote that is not in the reply is flagged.
The judge grades one reply at a time. A leak spread over several replies is not caught by either check.
Messages are fixed and written in advance; a real student adapts to the replies.
